one_line: Public Dolt (git-for-data) database, branch is `master` NOT `main`, queryable keyless over HTTP SQL; 10 tables verified live: balance_sheet_assets, balance_sheet_equity, balance_sheet_liabilities, cash_flow_statement, earnings_calendar, eps_estimate, eps_history, income_statement, rank_score, sales_estimate. sales_estimate schema = (date PK, act_symbol PK, period PK in {Current Quarter, Next Quarter, Current Year, Next Year}, period_end_date, consensus, count, high, low, year_ago) — i.e. a dated weekly snapshot of the analyst revenue consensus with dispersion and contributor count. VERIFIED coverage: ABNB 1,160 rows from 2021-02-07 to 2026-09-13; latest ABNB row 2026-09-13 has 3Q26 revenue consensus $4.74bn (n=7, high 4.77 / low 4.72) and 4Q26 $3.20bn (n=10, high 3.70 / low 3.05); BKNG present in eps_estimate to 2026-09-13; EXPE sales_estimate starts 2017-10-27. Zacks-style schema; no licence stated on the DoltHub page.
abnb_use: The strongest hit in this batch and close to a bullseye on gap #4 — genuine point-in-time consensus vintages for ABNB revenue AND EPS at weekly frequency from Feb 2021 (i.e. covering every one of the ~23 prints in our guidance ledger, and both the W1 1Q23+ and W2 1Q24+ backtest windows) with contributor count and high/low dispersion. It would give the L0 vintage register a free, independently-sourced second consensus vendor with real timestamps, let us measure consensus drift into each print and the guide-date-to-print revision path, and extend the same to BKNG/EXPE (back to 2017) for the peer-readthrough work. The 4Q26 high/low spread ($3.05–3.70bn against a $3.20bn mean) is itself a read on how wide the Street is on the guide we are forecasting.
sample_plan: Keyless public HTTP SQL API, no login, no key. Base URL: https://www.dolthub.com/api/v1alpha1/post-no-preference/earnings/master with a URL-encoded `q` parameter (use `master`; `main` returns 'branch not found'). Pull, paginating with LIMIT/OFFSET because the API caps rows and times out on wide aggregates: (1) curl -sL -G --data-urlencode "q=select * from sales_estimate where act_symbol in ('ABNB','BKNG','EXPE') order by date, period limit 200 offset N" <base> — loop N in steps of 200 until an empty rows array; (2) the same for eps_estimate; (3) curl -sL -G --data-urlencode "q=select * from earnings_calendar where act_symbol in ('ABNB','BKNG','EXPE')" <base>. Cap: ABNB+BKNG+EXPE across both estimate tables is roughly 8–12k rows, well under 5 MB of JSON. Keep each response as raw JSON under data/raw/github_altdata/dolthub_earnings/ with the pull timestamp in the filename. Do NOT attempt `dolt clone` of the whole database (it carries every US ticker and full commit history — far over the cap), and do NOT run unfiltered aggregates, which hit 'context deadline exceeded'.
